item.title: New VP-Pro MP11 Front Bumper
item.description: Following the other VP-Pro bumper releases, VP-Pro is excited to introduce their RS-935-MP11, specially designed front bumper for the Kyosho MP11.

item.title: Amain Hobbies Now Distributes HongNor Products
item.description: AMain Hobbies is pleased to announce an exclusive North American distribution agreement with HongNor, a legendary brand with over 35 years of competition engineering experience in RC racing.

item.title: Industry Analytics Weekly Stats [11/25 - 12/2]
item.description: The end of November and beginning of December sees a strong steady flow of racing entries across genres even with the Thanksgiving holiday taking place last week! Check out all the stats here. #IndustryAnalytics

item.title: Drake Talks Flash Point RC Steering Sleeves [VIDEO]
item.description: Adam Drake took some time this week to talk about the Flash Point Steering Sleeves for the Mugen Seiki 1/8th Scale Off-Road Vehicles.

item.title: New JConcepts JCI The Forge 12.3" Crawler Body
item.description: A thrilling follow-up to the popular Anvil, The Forge is the freshest release from JConcepts for 12.3” wheelbase crawler trucks.

item.title: New Ruddog RPS Power Supply
item.description: The RUDDOG RPS Power Supply delivers up to 750W at 12V and provides a continuous current of up to 62.5A, giving modern multi channel chargers and high power pit setups a stable and reliable energy source.

item.title: New Team Xray XB8/XT8 Stainless Steel Skid Plates
item.description: Team Xray has released new front and rear skid plates for the XB8/XT8 for both nitro and electric chassis.

item.title: New ProTek RC Traction Compound Applicator
item.description: Take control of your tire prep with the ProTek RC Traction Compound Bottle. This 2-pack of 40ml bottles makes applying liquid tire sauce clean, precise, and hassle-free.

item.title: New Element RC10 Trail Truck Cattleman Kit
item.description: A performance rig built to endure. When hitting the trail, you want to do it with confidence and the answer is the RC10 Trail Truck Cattleman Kit from Team Associated Element RC.

item.title: Amain Hobbies Announced as Executive JConcepts North American Distributor
item.description: AMain Hobbies is pleased to announce an exclusive North American distribution agreement with JConcepts, an iconic and industry-leading brand synonymous with producing some of the finest radio-controlled accessories for the past 20-plus years.
